Name: Black-White-Tuxedo Cat Recolors
Author: beachhotdog
Description:
I wanted to recolor the default cat to match my own kitties and thought it would be fun to share. The top row are more generic and the bottom row are based on my cats. Feel free to edit if you want different eye colors/coat colors in your game.

[s]How to Install:
Choose 1 kitty file. Rename it as cat.xnb and use it to replace the vanilla cat.xnb file. Don't forget to backup your vanilla files![/s]
[b]
